turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’ve had significantly increased sweating, and over the last 2 weeks my symptoms have worsened progressively and it’s taken less effort to cause them. I also have shortness of breath or difficulty breathing in a significant way, and I have chest/lower chest pain that’s been very intense (10/10), heavy, tedious, and exhausting.
Does the chest pain radiate anywhere, such as to your jaw, neck, back, or either of your arms?
Yes. It radiates to my biceps in both arms (R and L), to my thyroid cartilage, and to both shoulders (R and L).

Yes—I have diabetes, and I have had a heart attack or angina (chest pain) before. I’m also significantly overweight compared to people of the same height as I. I smoke cigarettes.
